note: Independent expectations for the mail layer. Every value is copied from the cited source, never from the output of the code under test. Hashes pin the cited file at the revision above; generate.mjs --check reports drift as unresolved.

otpMs.quote: How long a mailed sign-in code is accepted. CODE_TTL_MS = 10 * 60 * 1000

inviteSeconds.quote: Seven days ... the last second included (team-invite.js teamInviteAge)

otpMaxAttempts.quote: MAX_ATTEMPTS: wrong codes accepted for one address before the code is spent

retry.quote: decision 7: failed send backs off 5, 10, 20, 40 minutes; past 5 attempts the row is failed

groups.quote: decision 8: six groups x two channels, all on by default, Join requests locked on; T13 in About you, T12 and T14 in Site changes; a kind in no group is always on; adr0028 decision 6: a Viewer asking for edit access goes through the same pipeline as asking to join

kinds.source: adr0026 decision 2 (cases T2-T14, C1-C3) and the approved-copy header comments of letters/team.js and letters/comments.js; adr0028 decision 6 (A6-A6d: a Viewer asks for edit access through the same pipeline as asking to join, so each letter mirrors its join counterpart T2, T2b, T3, T4; Approve always makes an Editor, so no letter takes a role)

reservedDomains.source: RFC 2606 and RFC 6761 (reserved names no mailbox answers)

footer.ref: README.md, the footer paragraph (since 06/10/2026: Terms and Privacy are the two exceptions, both on tracy.ai, the sending domain)
footer.linksSource: footerCase, expect[1]: links to https://tracy.ai/terms and https://tracy.ai/privacy, the text part ends 'Terms: https://tracy.ai/terms · Privacy: https://tracy.ai/privacy'; in Vietnamese 'Điều khoản · Quyền riêng tư · tracy.ai'
excerpts: Terms and Privacy are the two exceptions, both on tracy.ai, the sending domain
the text part ends with the same two addresses

hostile.source: OWASP XSS filter evasion basics: markup, quote and ampersand characters in user-supplied text

secrets.source: adr0026 decision 4 and unsubscribe.js header: no secret, session key or signed value other than the intended link reaches a letter

unresolved: ADR 0005 states no sign-in code lifetime; the 10-minute value is pinned from lib/policy.js, which is code, so it is a contract source and not an independent one.
The exact boundary instant of a sign-in code (expiresAt === now) is not specified by any source; only before/after are asserted.
Translated sentences are not certified by any machine oracle; copy review is manual.

ADR 0026 names no group for T1 (team.invited); 'about-you' is assumed because the event is about the reader. A group the ADR does name is asserted as written; an assumed one is listed in groups.assumed and its switch case stays PENDING.

ADR 0028 decision 6 says only that asking for edit access uses the join-request pipeline; each A6 letter's button and group is taken from its join counterpart (T2, T2b, T3, T4), not stated by the ADR. The four kinds are in groups.assumed, so their switch cases stay PENDING.

catalogue.note: Explicit table: an assertion (and the variants it may judge) is eligible for PASS or product FAIL only through a row here. The row names the pinned source, the exact ref and invariant a case must carry, and the excerpts that must still be found verbatim in the pinned file. No row, a different ref or invariant, a variant outside the row, a drifted hash or a missing excerpt: the case is PENDING before any PASS or FAIL. An excerpt shows the source speaks about the invariant; it is chosen by a person, never derived from the code.
